name: AudioCaps
description: A large-scale dataset of approximately 46,000 10-second audio clips sourced from YouTube and annotated with human-written captions, designed for audio captioning research.
citation: Kim, C. D., Kim, B., Lee, H., & Kim, G. (2019). AudioCaps: Generating Captions for Audios in The Wild. Proceedings of NAACL-HLT 2019, 119–132. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/N19-1011

license.identifier: License not specified (not a standard SPDX identifier)
